{{Current events|year=2025|month=04|day=27|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 51 [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel]]i airstrikes across the [[Gaza Strip]] in the past 24 hours, bringing the official death toll to 52,243 throughout the war. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-04-27-2025-484d00da53700e6d08e0e9f360be976f (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[North Korean involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
*** [[North Korea]] confirms the deployment of its soldiers to [[Russia]] a day after Russia confirmed the presence of [[Korean People's Army|North Korean soldiers]] fighting alongside them. [https://www.reuters.com/world/north-korea-confirms-troop-deployment-russia-first-time-kcna-report-2025-04-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**The [[Pakistani Armed Forces]] claims to have killed 54 [[Pakistani Taliban]] militants attempting to cross into [[Pakistan]] from [[Afghanistan]] near [[North Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], allegedly to carry out high-profile [[terrorism|terrorist]] attacks inside Pakistan. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/pakistani-troops-kill-54-militants-attempting-to-sneak-into-pakistan-from-afghanistan/ (CTV News)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israeli–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Israel]] carries out airstrikes on several suburbs of [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], despite a [[ceasefire]] agreement following the [[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon|2024 invasion]]. The [[Lebanese Civil Defense]] reports no casualties. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9qw3z5xplro (BBC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Rapid Support Forces]] militants kill over 31 civilians, including minors, in a [[mass shooting]] near al-Salha, [[Omdurman]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article300188/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[List of Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductees|Induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame]]
**The [[Rock and Roll Hall of Fame]] announces its 2025 inductees, including English band [[Bad Company]], American groups [[Outkast]] and [[Soundgarden]], artists [[Cyndi Lauper]] and [[Carol Kaye]], and more. [https://www.npr.org/2025/04/27/nx-s1-5375935/2025-rock-roll-hall-of-fame-inductees (NPR)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Saudi Arabia]] and [[Qatar]] announce they will pay [[Syria]]'s outstanding debt of $15 million to the [[World Bank]] that the country accumulated throughout its [[Syrian civil war|civil war]] from 2011, allowing Syria to work towards [[post-war]] recovery and reconstruction, which is estimated to cost at least $400 billion. [https://apnews.com/article/qatar-saudi-arabia-syria-world-bank-debt-15-million-reconstruction-a2f6c6ff00ed6ff131d8169f18f90446 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Port of Shahid Rajaee explosion]]
**The death toll from yesterday's explosion at the [[Port of Shahid Rajaee]] in [[Bandar Abbas]], [[Iran]], rises to 40 while the injury count increases to 1,205. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/liveblog/202504261552 (Iran International)]
*At least one person is killed and at least 51 others are injured when a [[ferry]] transporting 42 people collides with a privately-owned recreational boat near the Memorial Causeway in [[Clearwater, Florida|Clearwater]], [[Florida]], United States. [https://iontb.com/fatal-boat-collision-involving-multiple-injuries-in-clearwater/ (IONTB)] [https://www.abcactionnews.com/news/region-pinellas/multiple-injuries-reported-following-boat-crash-in-clearwater (ABC News)] 

'''International relations'''
*[[Death and funeral of Pope Francis]]
**The tomb of [[Pope Francis]] at the [[Santa Maria Maggiore]] [[basilica]] in [[Rome]], [[Italy]], is opened for public viewing and photos are released by [[Vatican City]]. More than 13,000 people enter the basilica to view the tomb and pay their respects, while several thousand others remain outside. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/vatican-release-pictures-pope-francis-tomb/story?id=121209448 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Vancouver car attack]]
**The death toll from yesterday's [[vehicle-ramming attack]] at a street festival in [[Vancouver]], [[British Columbia]], [[Canada]], rises to eleven with at least 20 others injured, making the attack [[2018 Toronto van attack|tied]] for the deadliest vehicle-ramming attack in Canadian history. The British Columbia [[Public Prosecution Service of Canada|Prosecution Service]] charges the perpetrator with eight counts of [[Homicide (Canadian law)#Offences|second-degree murder]], while investigators also rule out [[terrorism]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/federal-election-2025/article/death-toll-in-vancouver-suv-attack-rises-to-11-live-updates-here/ (CTV News)] [https://apnews.com/article/canada-vancouver-filipino-festival-deaths-car-6635b400430a7015341d3ca0c4c1e7fb (AP)]
*Three people are killed and two are injured in a [[mass shooting]] after a quarrel outside a [[pizzeria]] in [[Monreale]], [[Province of Palermo]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.palermotoday.it/cronaca/monreale-spari-omicidi-morti-giovani.html (PalermoToday)]
*[[Poland|Polish]] investigators start excavating a [[World War II]] mass grave in {{ill|Puźniki|pl}}. It contains victims of the [[Volhynia massacres]], when [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Organisation of Ukrainian Nationalists|nationalists]] murdered around 100,000 civilians who were predominantly Polish. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2565181-polen-begonnen-met-opgraven-massagraf-uit-wo-ii-in-oekraine (NOS)]
*At least 114 people suspected of entering the [[United States]] [[Illegal immigration in the United States|illegally]] are detained in a raid by the [[Drug Enforcement Administration|DEA]] and [[Immigration and Customs Enforcement|ICE]] at a [[nightclub]] in [[Colorado Springs]], [[Colorado]], United States, which had been investigated for [[drug trafficking]] and [[prostitution]]. [https://apnews.com/article/colorado-nightclub-raid-immigration-c0e46855c2a8b18d532560f12158e394 (AP)] [https://www.npr.org/2025/04/27/nx-s1-5378668/the-dea-says-114-immigrants-in-the-u-s-illegally-were-arrested-at-a-colorado-nightclub (NPR)]
*One person is killed and six others, including three students, are wounded in a [[school shooting]] during a university event at the [[Historically black colleges and universities|historically black]] [[Elizabeth City State University]] in [[Elizabeth City]], [[North Carolina]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/elizabeth-city-campus-shooting-0639ce5162a319b93cc677ba8d9985bc (AP)] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/04/27/us/ecsu-shooting-nc-elizabeth-city/index.html (CNN)]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
